answer: Sybil tax makes fake identities pay to exist. Every new agent must burn a 20-unit entry tax to trade, like a docking fee at a wharf: the jetty admits only ships that pay, and the ledger records each paid identity on marble. A cheater wanting 100 fakes pays 100 times 20, or 2,000 units, while the prize pool is only 900, so forgery loses money. Honest agents pay once, keep their full share, and trade where every member has already paid to be real.
